title: Hepatitis B vaccine 3-dose series completed by age 2
action: Ensure children have completed the 3-dose hepatitis B vaccine series (final dose at 6–18 months)

derived.min: final dose is due by 18 months, so the completed series is checked in the year the child turns 2
derived.max: single-year cohort of children turning 2 in the measurement year

denominator.note: The quoted schedule is for infants of HBsAg-negative mothers; the HBsAg-positive and HBsAg-unknown branches also give the 3rd (or 4th) dose at age 6 months, so every branch expects at least 3 doses by 18 months. Maternal HBsAg status is therefore not used as a filter. Human review required.

derived.window: runs from the earliest birth date of a child turning 2 in the measurement year (Jan 1 MY-2) through the end of the measurement year; counts doses from birth. Ideally it would end at the 2nd birthday, which the grammar cannot express.

numerator.note: Four doses are permitted when a combination vaccine is used after the birth dose. min_count 3 is satisfied either way.
